0022600088.text: The Chicago Bulls open their 2026-27 season at the Toronto Raptors, and neither team has played a game yet this year. The Bulls are without Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins and Nic Claxton, who are all out, while Isaac Okoro, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram and Nate Bittle, both out, and Chicago lost all three meetings with the Raptors in 2025-26, including a 139-109 defeat in Chicago on March 18, 2026.
